Hana must come before Finn, Ivo, Gus, Ben, Dev, and Elif, so she is in slot 1. Finn is immediately after her (slot 2), and the only slot exactly two away from Hana is 3, so Cara is there.

The Ann–Gus block then has to be slots 5–6. Dev must sit two away from Elif, after Ivo, Ben, and Gus, and at least three from Ann, which forces Elif in 7, Ivo in 8, and Dev in 9, with Ben in 4. Every other placement breaks at least one ordering or gap constraint.
